# Repository instructions

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) before making changes. These are the canonical repository rules; do not maintain a conflicting copy here.

Communicate in Chinese. Keep changes scoped, preserve other contributors' work, and report actual validation results. Run `npm run check`, and run `npm run test:e2e` for gameplay or module wiring changes. Never weaken checks to hide failures.
